cross_package_notes.note: Verified read-only cross-package contract for default Elasticsearch index name "xwrag_default" in v7/v8 repositories: VectorStoreConfig.ResolveIndexName and service-layer retriever tests explicitly expect "xwrag_default" when ELASTICSEARCH_INDEX is unset, while OpenSearch defaults to "genyee" and Doris defaults to "genyee_embeddings".

Verified read-only cross-package RetrieveParams callers populate non-empty KnowledgeBaseIDs on every search invocation and pass GOMAXPROCS=2 go test -race -p 1 -count=1 ./internal/application/service/retriever/... (exit 0).

invariants_checked: Shared Elasticsearch DTO converters ToDBVectorEmbedding and FromDBVectorEmbeddingWithScore guard against nil inputs without panicking and default missing legacy is_enabled pointers to true.
VectorEmbedding omits nil/empty embedding slices (omitempty) so keyword-only documents can be indexed into Elasticsearch without sending null to dense_vector mappings.

Shared validation helpers enforce finite float32 embeddings (rejecting NaN/Inf), mandatory non-empty KnowledgeBaseIDs for tenant-scoped retrieval, non-blank delete/update target IDs, bounded TopK [1..10000], and URL credential redaction; zero legacy brand residues present.

findings.summary: ToDBVectorEmbedding and FromDBVectorEmbeddingWithScore dereferenced nil IndexInfo/VectorEmbeddingWithScore pointers without guards, and VectorEmbedding serialized nil embeddings as "embedding": null instead of omitting the field on keyword-only saves.

invariants_checked: All Elasticsearch v7 query, delete-by-query, update-by-query, and bulk action bodies are marshaled via encoding/json structs/maps with zero fmt.Sprintf raw JSON string interpolation.

VectorRetrieve and KeywordsRetrieve fail closed when KnowledgeBaseIDs is empty or whitespace-only, never falling back to cross-tenant match_all or unscoped BM25 queries, and enforce bounded TopK and finite Threshold/Embedding inputs.

Bulk (_bulk) and by-query (_delete_by_query, _update_by_query) HTTP 200 responses are read through bounded io.LimitReader wrappers and checked for item/shard failures without leaking cluster reason or raw response bodies; defer res.Body.Close() is scoped per request rather than accumulated inside loops.
DeleteBy*, BatchUpdateChunk*, MoveKnowledgeIndices, and CopyIndices reject blank target/scope identifiers so empty slices or blank IDs never mutate unintended documents.

findings.summary: buildVectorSearchQuery fell back to match_all across all tenants when KnowledgeBaseIDs was empty and buildKeywordSearchQuery omitted knowledge_base_id requirements on empty slices while constructing query DSL via fmt.Sprintf and dropping TopK ("size") and Threshold ("min_score"); deleteByFieldList also built _delete_by_query via fmt.Sprintf and ignored HTTP 200 partial failures.

processHit hardcoded MatchTypeKeywords even for VectorRetrieve hits (and dereferenced nil _score without guard), Save rejected valid keyword-only documents despite Support() advertising KeywordsRetrieverType, BatchUpdateChunkTagID deferred res.Body.Close() inside a loop without inspecting HTTP 200 failures, HTTP bodies lacked io.LimitReader bounds and leaked raw resp.String() on errors, and MoveKnowledgeIndices/CopyIndices accepted blank KB IDs.

invariants_checked: All Elasticsearch v8 typed SDK requests serialize script parameters and query filters via json.Marshal / typed structs with zero raw string concatenation into json.RawMessage.

VectorRetrieve and KeywordsRetrieve fail closed on empty/blank KnowledgeBaseIDs, validate finite query vectors and thresholds, clamp TopK to [1..10000], and guard nullable hit Score_ and Id_ pointers.
Bulk, DeleteByQuery, and UpdateByQuery responses inspect Errors and Failures slices without exposing cluster-side reason text or URL credentials in returned errors.

Save supports keyword-only documents in parity with BatchSave, CopyIndices preserves TagID and IsRecommended metadata, and DeleteBy*/BatchUpdateChunk*/MoveKnowledgeIndices/CopyIndices reject blank target/scope IDs.

findings.summary: BatchUpdateChunkTagID constructed Painless script parameter JSON via unescaped string concatenation json.RawMessage("\"" + tagID + "\""), allowing quotes, backslashes, or control characters in tagID to break or inject into the _update_by_query JSON payload.

VectorRetrieve fell back to cross-tenant MatchAll when KnowledgeBaseIDs was empty, KeywordsRetrieve executed unscoped content queries when KnowledgeBaseIDs was empty (and omitted MinScore when Threshold > 0), and both methods unconditionally dereferenced nullable *hit.Score_ and *hit.Id_ pointers.

Save rejected keyword-only documents, CopyIndices dropped TagID and IsRecommended during KB index copies, DeleteByQuery and UpdateByQuery ignored HTTP 200 partial Failures, and DeleteBy*/BatchUpdateChunk*/MoveKnowledgeIndices/CopyIndices lacked blank target/KB ID validation.

invariants_checked: OpenSearch query DSL (buildKNNQuery, buildKeywordQuery, deleteByTerms, updateByQueryScript, MoveKnowledgeIndices, copyScanBatch) uses typed structs/maps via encoding/json with Painless parameters passed exclusively via bound params.
Retrieve fails closed with ErrConfigInvalid when KnowledgeBaseIDs is empty or whitespace-only or Threshold is NaN/Inf, and validates finite float32 vectors on Save, BatchSave, and VectorRetrieve.

inspectBulkResponse and inspectByQueryResponse fail closed on HTTP 200 partial errors (including errors=true without per-item error objects and _delete_by_query failures) while keeping cluster-side reason text out of public errors and capping HTTP response reads with io.LimitReader.

Save and BatchSave key OpenSearch document _id by SourceID (falling back to ChunkID) so generated-question vectors sharing a chunk_id do not overwrite primary chunk documents, CopyIndices defaults missing legacy is_enabled to true, SSRF and TLS/credential redaction invariants hold, and default base index is "genyee".

findings.summary: Retrieve allowed empty/blank KnowledgeBaseIDs to execute cross-tenant searches across the shared index (and allowed NaN thresholds/vectors); Save and buildBulkBody keyed _id=info.ChunkID instead of SourceID causing generated questions ("<chunk>-<q>") to overwrite primary chunks in the same index; inspectBulkResponse returned nil when errors=true had empty items or status>=400 without an error object; and deleteByTerms discarded _delete_by_query HTTP 200 failure bodies.

CopyIndices decoded missing legacy is_enabled fields as false instead of defaulting to true, and CopyIndices, MoveKnowledgeIndices, deleteByList, and BatchUpdateChunk* accepted empty/whitespace KB or chunk target identifiers.

invariants_checked: Every Doris SQL query and HTTP Stream Load endpoint validates database and table identifiers against strict [a-zA-Z0-9_]{1,64} allowlists, filters information_schema table listings to canonical <tableBaseName>_<positiveDim> names, binds all user string filters/IDs via ? placeholders, and formats validated finite float32 arrays via strconv.FormatFloat.

VectorRetrieve and KeywordsRetrieve require non-empty KnowledgeBaseIDs (failing closed instead of scanning across tenants), clamp TopK to [1..10000], reject NaN/Inf thresholds or empty vectors, propagate errors when all queried tables fail, and preserve scanned IsEnabled flags.

Stream Load HTTP client enforces SSRF validation on initial FE requests and 307 FE->BE redirects, blocks HTTPS downgrades, untrusted hosts, and embedded redirect userinfo, bounds response reads to 1 MiB, and truncates + redacts URL credentials in error previews.
resolveCompatMode caches only successful mode detection under a mutex so transient DB/network errors retry cleanly; default table prefix is "genyee_embeddings" with zero legacy brand residues.

findings.summary: Doris SQL builders interpolated r.tableBaseName, tables returned from information_schema.tables LIKE, and dimension without strict identifier/positive-dimension validation; VectorRetrieve and KeywordsRetrieve allowed empty KnowledgeBaseIDs to execute cross-tenant queries across shared tables; and KeywordsRetrieve panicked on negative TopK (all[:params.TopK]) and silently returned empty success when every table query failed.

resolveCompatMode used sync.Once and permanently cached transient DB/network errors for the lifetime of the repository; streamLoadOnce interpolated unbounded result.Message and unredacted result.ErrorURL into returned errors (and CheckRedirect did not reject embedded userinfo on redirects); scanRetrieveRows dropped scanned IsEnabled values; and DeleteBy*/BatchUpdateChunk*/MoveKnowledgeIndices/CopyIndices lacked blank target/KB ID validation.
